name: Modestino Rodrigues
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Brazilian middleweight (8-1, age 23) who knocked out Brandon Holmes in 15 seconds on the Contender Series in September. This is his UFC debut.

how_they_fight.Striking: All eight wins by knockout, six in R1.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Has never needed more than two rounds.

concerns: Knocked out in R1 once himself
keys_to_beat: Survive his first minutes; take him to R2-R3

sources.author: Mike Heck
sources.title: UFC Saudi Arabia: Several new bouts added to Israel Adesanya vs. Shara Magomedov fight card
